name: Casifier
description: Casifier wraps movie primary posters in DVD, Blu-ray, and Ultra HD case artwork based on video resolution. It can run on a schedule and after Jellyfin library scans.
overview: Generate media-case posters for Jellyfin movies.

versions.changelog: Movie Versions: compact numbered list with expandable details; copies whose runtime is far from the film they matched (misidentified episodes) are left out and listed separately; among copies of the same quality, the one with more languages is kept instead of the higher-bitrate one. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer.
